proteinmpnn.name: ProteinMPNN
proteinmpnn.primary_budget: up to 150 development epochs; 0.10 A backbone noise; exact frozen 900/100 IDs; validation-selected epoch count refit from scratch on exact full 1000

rna_fixbb.name: MPNN-fixbb / NA-MPNN
rna_fixbb.primary_budget: up to ~150 development data passes under official token batching; RNA_BACKBONE_NOISE=0.10 A; exact frozen 900/100 IDs; selected pass count refit on exact full 1000

rules: These SHAs were frozen on 2026-09-05 before pilot execution.
Never move an upstream checkout for a reported run without creating a new experiment version.
Primary baselines start from random initialization. Published weights are reported only in a separate reference track.
All preprocessing losses/exclusions are reported; samples are never silently replaced for only one method.
External one-sided baselines do not receive partner identity and are not used as the sole evidence for cross-molecular coupling.
